workItem: Implement policy-bound per-PR auto-merge and exact routing into the canonical branch synchronization workflow.
workItemDE: Jeden Pull Request fail-closed gegen den Auto-Merge Safety Contract klassifizieren, zulässige PRs nach Exact-Head-Revalidierung über GitHub Auto-Merge armen und CURRENT_MAIN-Drift exakt an den bestehenden kanonischen Branch-Sync-Workflow delegieren.
priorityReason: Reduziert manuelle Merge- und Synchronisationsschritte, ohne Human/CODEOWNER-Schutzklassen, Required Checks oder den kanonischen Branch-Writer zu umgehen.
exitGate: Every open same-repository PR against main is evaluated fail-closed; only exact-head/current-base AUTO_MERGE_ELIGIBLE PRs with all required evidence PASS are armed through GitHub provider auto-merge after a fresh Governance revalidation; protected classes remain HUMAN_MERGE_REQUIRED; trusted stale PRs route only to the existing canonical branch-sync writer.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct agent self-merge and no second PR-body or branch-sync writer.
